units.source_text: 朱雀院又把近来所思之事详细告知源氏，便中提及：“我抛开了许多女儿而遁入空门，心中实甚挂念。

en.t: Suzaku-in also told Genji in detail what had been on his mind lately, and in the course of it said, “I left many daughters behind when I entered the religious life, and I am deeply concerned about them.

units.source_text: 其中别无依靠的三公主，尤可担心，不知如何处置才好。”

en.t: Among them, the Third Princess, who has no one else to rely on, worries me especially, and I do not know what should be done for her.”

units.source_text: 源氏知道这话有言外之意，对他甚是同情。

en.t: Genji understood that there was an unspoken meaning in these words, and he felt great sympathy for him.

units.source_text: 又因他自己心中也想一看三公主的模样，故不能漠然，便乘机言道：“此事诚属可虑。

en.t: Since he himself also wished to see what the Third Princess was like, he could not remain indifferent, and he seized the occasion to say, “This is indeed a matter for concern.

units.source_text: 身为皇女之人，若无体贴入微之保护人，比寻常女子更感困苦。

en.t: A woman born as an imperial princess suffers even more than an ordinary woman if she has no protector who will care for her with delicate attention.

units.source_text: 但她哥哥是皇太子，而且在这末世是一位非常贤明的储君，为天下人所仰望而信赖。

en.t: But her elder brother is the Crown Prince, and even in these latter days he is an exceptionally wise heir, admired and trusted by everyone under heaven.

units.source_text: 只要你为父的将此人托付与他，想他决不会略有疏忽。

en.t: If you, as her father, entrust her to him, I am sure he will not neglect her in the least.

units.source_text: 故三公主将来之事，可请放心。

en.t: Therefore, as for the Third Princess’s future, you may set your mind at ease.

units.source_text: 不过世事都有限度，将来皇太子即了帝位，政务顺遂，日理万机，深恐亦无暇对一女子寄予深切的关怀。

en.t: Yet everything in the world has its limits, and when the Crown Prince ascends the throne, governs smoothly, and attends to countless affairs each day, I fear he may have no leisure to give deep care to one woman.

units.source_text: 凡为女子者，若要一个万事皆能诚恳照拂的保护人，必须其人与此女缔结姻缘，

en.t: For any woman, if she is to have a protector who will sincerely look after everything for her, that person must be joined to her in marriage,

units.source_text: 视为不可避免的天职而守护她，方可安心。

en.t: and only when he guards her as an unavoidable duty entrusted by fate can one feel at ease.

units.source_text: 吾兄倘谓此事乃修行之障碍，将遗恨于来生，则莫如以妥善之法选择贤才，而秘密决定一适当之人为婿。”

en.t: If my elder brother feels that this matter is an obstacle to his religious practice and may leave him with regret in the life to come, it would be best to choose a worthy man by proper means and secretly decide on a suitable husband for her.”

units.source_text: 朱雀院答道：“我也有此想法，然而此事亦甚困难。

en.t: Suzaku-in replied, “I too have had that thought, but this matter is also very difficult.

units.source_text: 据我所闻古代事例，父皇在位、气运昌盛之时，亦有为公主选定夫婿，使任保护之责者，且其例甚多。

en.t: From what I have heard of ancient precedents, even when the imperial father was on the throne and fortune was at its height, there were many cases in which husbands were chosen for princesses and made responsible for protecting them.

units.source_text: 何况像我这样即将遗世之人，选婿当然并不苛求。

en.t: All the more so for someone like me, who is about to leave the world behind; naturally I would not be exacting in choosing a husband.

units.source_text: 但在既经抛舍之尘世中，尚有此难于抛舍之事，因此身受种种烦恼，病势日见沉重。

en.t: Yet in this world I have already cast away, there still remains something I cannot cast away, and because of this I suffer many anxieties, while my illness grows heavier day by day.

units.source_text: 又念日月推迁，一去不返，心中不胜焦灼。

en.t: When I also think that the days and months pass on and never return, my heart is unbearably impatient.

units.source_text: 今我有一不情之请：可否请吾弟破格接受这一个皇女，听凭尊意替她选定一个适当的夫婿？

en.t: Now I have an unreasonable request: could I ask my younger brother to make an exception and take charge of this imperial daughter, and at your own discretion choose a suitable husband for her?

units.source_text: 你家中纳言未娶之时，我悔不及早提出。

en.t: I regret that I did not raise this earlier, before the Chūnagon of your household had married.

units.source_text: 今被太政大臣捷足先占，教我好生妒羡！”

en.t: Now the Chancellor has got ahead of me and taken him first, which makes me terribly envious and jealous!”

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“中纳言为人诚实，确实信赖得过。

en.t: Genji replied, “The Chūnagon is an honest man, and he can certainly be trusted.

units.source_text: 但年事尚幼，阅世不深，恐多疏误之处。

en.t: But he is still young and has little experience of the world, so I fear there would be many things he might overlook.

units.source_text: 恕我冒昧直陈：三公主若得我尽心照拂，当与在父亲荫庇之下无异。

en.t: Forgive my bold frankness: if the Third Princess were to receive my devoted care, it would be no different from being under her father’s protection.

units.source_text: 只是我来日苦短，深恐中途捐弃，反而教她受累耳。”

en.t: Only, my remaining days are sadly few, and I deeply fear that if I were to leave her midway, I would instead cause her hardship.”

units.source_text: 他已表示接受了。

en.t: He had already shown that he accepted the request.
